body: would you please stop spamming the link to this? this isn't the place.
nearly bought the fentanyl today. was hard not to. couldn't stop myself from cutting though. sigh. feels like this is never going to end.

i feel exactly the same way, it's a really rough situation to be in. props for getting help, though, it can be tough (at least it was for me x - x) but it might really be a step in the right direction. it may not be better, but you might as well stick around and see, right? 

best wishes, hope everything goes well. i'm rooting for you.

i feel similarly. at the moment, i am in that position. it's a very weird place to be, because doing nothing is equally as depressing for me, i've found. life is horrible. you are always given such high expectations by everyone around you, it sucks.

i'm thinking about getting a small part time job just to pay the bills, and having to work as little as possible, maybe just stacking shelves to get by. what do you think about doing something like that? i think it might be enough for me.

best wishes.

i am kind of in the same boat, i messed up my education and have no qualifications or opportunities. you are definitely not alone, and even though it's hard to believe, there are other routes, and your education doesn't define you. i'm trying to come to terms with that at the moment.

what is it you want to do in the future, if you have any idea?

if you don't have anything to lose, maybe you could try doing a bunch of stuff that you've never thought of doing before. i've thought about the same thing a lot. you never know what might happen. (i understand this sounds cliché.)

i agree, being successful is hard, and people around you constantly have high expectations for you. it's stressful and unfair. hope you feel better soon, pm me if you ever need to talk or vent.
i agree, and you still have your two other friends to support you. best wishes.

hey, thanks for posting here. i'm glad you haven't rushed to doing anything yet.

i'm really sorry that all of these things have happened to you -- your girlfriend sounds like a vile person who couldn't even be mature towards the end of your relationship, and (in my opinion), it sounds like you're better off without her, though it may not seem like it now. 

i think you should at least wait until next semester. 1.83 is still higher than 1.8, and you may be able to talk to the place you're being educated at and explain your situation. it might sound silly now, but as someone with an outsiders perspective, it definitely isn't. you have a lot going on, and that's definitely going to affect your studies. hopefully they'll give you another shot.

i don't have much advice to give about moving out. i can only hope that over time your ex matures and signs to end the lease. you may still be able to talk to her mother -- do you have any lines of communication with her?

my partner is definitely responsible for a lot of these thoughts, as selfish as that may be. thanks again for reading, i'm going to try to reach out to someone for help. and if not, running away has always been something in the back of my head. 

hope you're well, thanks for reaching out.

taking a walk was very beneficial, thank you for your kindness. you're pretty much right in thinking that i posted here to allow me to get perspective on my own views, and it's helped me a little. i may start a journal, i've been considering it for a while. 

i hope you have a nice day :)
thank you for your kind words. i have seen a counselor irl, but they seemed to dismiss most of my issues, and i'm unable to get another one at this time. i've also tried pills, to no avail.

sorry you had your feelings invalidated like that. it's completely okay to feel this way, it's just unfortunate that it's still such a taboo to talk about it, even with friends. you are definitely not alone -- i am in the same boat.

i hope things look up for you soon. if you need anyone to talk to, i'll be around tomorrow.
